title: Apply the decision to the refresh workflow and land one refresh PR on a counting check
goal: Apply the decision to the refresh workflow and land one refresh PR on a counting check
acceptance: A refresh PR shows a passing check and is merged with merge-when-green
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Verified 2026-11-24: after PR #6 merged, a dispatched refresh run (45507081422) passed the secret check, started from main and opened PR #7 with REFRESH_TOKEN; PR #7's pull_request CI run (45507149360) started by itself and showed as its check (statusCheckRollup: check SUCCESS); PR #7 landed with merge-when-green.

prs.note: first refresh PR with its own CI check
